icp.rationale: Industry is set to Software Development (5 of 5 seeds). The description's wider ranges override the seed traits, which are all Series A and USA (5 of 5 each), so the filters use Seed to Series B, USA and India, and 20-200 employees (only 3 of 5 seeds are in the 20-50 band). Growth (4 of 5 seeds at 0-25%) is not a hard filter and only affects scoring. Buyers are senior sales leaders (Head of Sales, VP Sales, CRO), matching the persona hypothesis. The Sales function filter will exclude CEO/Founders and may miss some RevOps titles.
